about: Packages whose published advisories are known and waited on, each until a date. After the date the audit check fails again. See tools/lib_audit.js.

waivers.reason: 2.5.1 has published advisories (fixed in 3.x and 4.x). The app only makes a PDF of your own trip with it. Upgrading needs the package registry and the new file's integrity hash, which the session that added this check could not reach.
